confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on undated, crowdsourced cost-of-living pages (MyLifeElsewhere, combien-coute.net) and a general guide (Chasing the Donkey), with no current Bodrum price list found. Cocktail and wine anchors are judgment estimates tied to beer (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer) because no Bodrum bar or wine prices were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could retrieve (20 March 2026), not a verified current one.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bodrum is an Aegean resort town in Turkey, which is transcontinental; it is grouped with Europe because its tourist price levels are closest to southern European Mediterranean resorts. Food and drink anchors use Turkish resort-town cost-of-living aggregates, with the meal range from Chasing the Donkey. One comparison site places Bodrum about 17 percent below Athens overall and about 16 percent below Athens for restaurants. Accommodation is a model estimate informed by the same comparison.
